user.description: Sign in with your EDF email and password and the integration creates an API key for you. Only the key is stored, never your password. Creating a key replaces any EDF API key you already use elsewhere.

user.title: Track a device's peak and off-peak cost
user.description: Pick a power sensor (W or kW) or an energy sensor (Wh or kWh) for something like an EV charger or hot tub. Its usage is split into peak and off-peak and priced at your EDF rates, live and for past days from Home Assistant's history. The sensor needs long-term statistics (a state class) for the history part.

data_description.source_entity: An energy sensor (kWh) is best: its history is exact. A power sensor (W) also works.
data_description.power_entity: Only needed if the main sensor is an energy sensor and you want a live Current cost.
